mandatory: Exactly five equal-width columns with even gaps
Every column header sits on ONE line; the text after the middle dot never moves to a second line; headers are bold near-black
Under each header, one soft blue product chip; all five chips have the same height

Under each chip, one tall card of the same height in every column, each with a small open-padlock icon: columns 1 and 3 soft green with a green border; columns 2, 4 and 5 light grey with a grey border
The cards fill the column down to about 80% of the frame height, so there is no empty area between the cards and the band
The title reads exactly 'When each change may happen', bold, top-left, one line, in the same large size as a slide title
Every string in text_exact appears exactly once, spelled exactly as written
prohibitions: NO arrows or connectors of any kind
NO bar or callout other than the one grey band at the bottom
NO sixth column, no Step 6 or Step 7
NO numbers other than the step numbers 1 to 5 in the headers
NO command text, shell syntax, flags or flag values of any kind (no 'gcloud', 'curl', 'bq', 'agy -p', '--', '$', '|', 'stream-json')
NO URLs, hostnames or file paths other than the file names listed in text_exact
NO project IDs, project numbers, regions, or email addresses (nothing containing '@', 'projects/' or 'iam.gserviceaccount.com')
NO logos of any kind, including Google, Google Cloud, Gemini or Antigravity logos
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes, robots, mascots or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact: no extra labels, numbers, step numbers, captions, legend, footnote or source note
NO identifier (file name or login name) broken across two lines
NO word broken at a hyphen
NO grey or faint text for any label; every label is semibold near-black #1F2328
NO quotation marks or apostrophes around the title or any label

Step 2, Inspect: IAM and BigQuery; reports the power, changes nothing (gray card). Step 3, Separate: Agent Runtime and Cloud Run; seven changes, fixed order (green card). Step 4, Cut off: BigQuery access list; removes only what remains (gray card). Step 5, Prove: Cloud Audit Logs; proves it, changes nothing (gray card). Each card has an open padlock. A band below reads: Says only what its own re-read showed.
